art_instructions: Center the composition on the open, blue-trimmed double doors of the small Greek village school, creating a clear transition from the sunny whitewashed porch and garden (left) into the cozy classroom interior (right). Outside, show terracotta roof edge and a wooden porch post, a stone path coming from the lower left past a small stone bird bath, with bougainvillea climbing near the doorway and an olive tree framing the far left. Inside, show soft blue walls washed with bright natural light from a window, low honey-colored desks grouped on a colorful woven rug, and a small green plant near the door. Panda (slightly taller than Koala) is mid-step over the threshold at center-left, facing right, smiling wide; one paw lifts in a friendly wave while the other touches the door edge. Koala, with leaf-green scarf and acorn-brown backpack, stands just inside at center-right, turned back toward friends with a happy open-mouthed grin, one paw raised to beckon them in. Dinosaur, pea-green with a pale mint belly and a small red backpack, is on the stone path a step behind Panda at lower left, lifting one foot in a cheerful hop and raising both hands in excitement. Owl, mottled brown-and-cream with a green scarf and tiny satchel, glides low from the shaded porch through the doorway at kids’ eye level, wings half-open and eyes bright, clearly joining the entry. Everyone’s expressions and forward motion show that they rejoice and are entering; no mice are visible now, and the bright outdoor sun blends with warm indoor light to emphasize a happy, welcoming moment. Keep sizes consistent: Panda and Dinosaur child-height and similar, Koala a bit shorter, Owl about head-height while gliding.
